title: Jerome, Commentary on Daniel (trans. Gleason L. Archer, 1958) — chapter 10
license: Page states: "All material on this page is in the public domain"; paraphrased

verification_log.method: Read the chapter 10 commentary in the downloaded page

Reconciles 1:21 with 10:1 (Daniel kept his rank until Cyrus's first year); the 24th of the first month is in Nisan; the prince of Persia is the angel to whom Persia was committed (Deut 32:8, "according to the number of the angels of God"); Michael has oversight of Israel; "chief princes" = archangels; the prince of the Greeks came in when Alexander overthrew Persia; Symmachus renders "one like unto a man"
